\(1/2\) 阈值，并选出 critical-log 最小边界。R0.72G 在 exact real one-carrier lattice 上用 phase gauge、目标行恒等式与 Rolle–BV 归约证明完整根质量恰为对数量级，并得到 critical-log complete-root sharp saturation。R0.72H 在有限共轭配对多载波系统中证明 mixed caustic stratification 未完成。R0.72S 进一步把 fixed-first-harmonic \(1{:}2{:}3\) 的 marked incidence preimages 精确分为 \(A_2,A_3,A_4,A_5\)，用 determinant \(5400\) 证明 modulo constants 的 restricted miniversal，并对 pure-second \(A_2\) 与 real-even \(A_3\) 两条 heat path 分别给出 \(4/3/2\) 与 \(4/2/2\) 的 distinct count；后者只在 real-even slice 内横截。这里没有完成 global caustic image，也没有证明一般三维 Navier--Stokes 正则性。R0.72T--W 固定并闭合 exact alpha^2，standard endpoint 没有 vanishing alpha gain。exact zero-coupling lift-up 说明 epsilon-only full-row closure 与 every-row strict contraction 为 FALSE。R0.72Z 在 high-gap \(q\)-graph 上闭合 signed OS OPEN。R0.73C 随后用 exact cubic neutral spectrum 与 validated periodic-ODE monodromy sign certificate 证明一条 infinite-dimensional frozen Rayleigh instability；viscous fast-time transfer 仍为 OPEN，super-polynomial complete-row no-go 只为 CONDITIONAL。R0.73D 再在精确 kinetic space 中证明认证无黏谱簇的 static vanishing-viscosity persistence、Riesz 投影算子范数收敛和代数重数保持；一般先例属于 Shvydkoy--Friedlander，补空间与快时间传递仍为 OPEN。
en: Among them, R0.69P–R0.71P reaches the positive-entry temporal-packing boundary, while R0.71Q–U gives the boundaries for conditional incidence, genuine internal-entry, second-time-jet, and finite recurrence. R0.71V–W separates the fixed zero-level trace and rules out a data-uniform complete first-row ledger. R0.71X, within a fixed-dimensional small-coupling family, reaches the one-third endpoint; R0.71Y treats selected roots; R0.71Z gives the all-root slope-mass bound and launch-inclusive floor cancellation. R0.72A localizes the strong-coupling loss to the actual observation layer, R0.72B retains exact target-row participation, and R0.72C obtains phase-uniform exact-launch \(M^{-8/3}\) and fixed-positive tail \(M^{-3}\) as the sharp algebraic scales. R0.72D, on a shifted Rudin–Shapiro family, constructs a positive-time exact root, retains the full rotational charge, and obtains a normalized complete-root ledger that does not vanish but does not diverge. R0.72E returns to a fixed-carrier Bessel family and uses quantitative negative-Sobolev action to prove that the complete-root ledger, relative to the candidate \(D^{1/3}\Lambda_1\) payment, diverges like \(R^{4/3}\). R0.72F then uses regularly varying initial-layer weights to separate the selected-root \(1/3\) threshold from the Leray payment \(1/2\) threshold and identifies the minimal critical-log boundary. R0.72G, on an exact real one-carrier lattice, uses a phase gauge, the target-row identity, and Rolle–BV reduction to prove that the complete root mass is exactly of logarithmic order, yielding critical-log complete-root sharp saturation. R0.72H proves for the mixed row a carrier-count-independent moment-resolved payment; the all-odd Rudin–Shapiro family rules out the action-only version and makes the carrier power encoded by that moment attain the same order. R0.72I proves that the separated positive \(B_AQ_*\) term cannot be absorbed physically term by term, while joint exposure and odd-carrier parity prove uniform decay of the genuine complete ledger. R0.72J completes the bipartite classification of the gcd-reduced Cayley graph, distinguishes an odd cycle from a triangle return, and proves that a common-band coherent mixed-parity cubic still decays after physical normalization. R0.72K, through a root-by-root gap norming direction, closes the complete complex-target ledger and proves that its common-band physical normalization ratio still decays uniformly. R0.72L retains the actual enstrophy contrast and critical-log action and closes, as \(R\) grows, a moderate strong-coupling window; the upper edge of the window gives only \(O(1)\), while only the little-o subwindow decays. R0.72M determines the scalar action danger window exactly and, on the complete one-carrier zero-diffusion chain, proves the Bessel action-poor benchmark and sharp logarithmic cubic law. R0.72N rules out the declared launch action-poor route on the complete dissipative chain and, from Coble–He time-dependent shear decay, derives the site's corollary \(\mathcal C_{\rm diss}\lesssim a^2\sqrt\sigma\). R0.72O reinserts this cubic into the physical ledger, obtaining an \(\varepsilon^{11/6}\) numerator and an \(R^{4/3}L_{R,\varepsilon}^2\) window; the multicarrier statement is conditional on a full-superposition ED hypothesis with a uniform constant. R0.72P closes the complete propagation gate on the fixed real-collinear static-phase 1:2 positive class, and R0.72Q then, for fixed-\(M\), arbitrary-static-phase, and \(Q_2\le1/2\), proves the two-critical-point shape gate together with an exact 1:2 caustic. R0.72R constructs a four-real-dimensional rational polydisc lying entirely outside the old weighted cone, for every \(y\ge0\) closes full-heat-path root localization, and, for \(0\le y\le1\), closes the physical \((\pi/48,144,240)\) shape contract and coefficient-uniform fixed-pattern commensurate 1:2:3 triangular affine-row enhanced dissipation; the complete four-dimensional caustic stratification is unfinished. R0.72S further takes the fixed-first-harmonic \(1{:}2{:}3\) marked incidence preimages and classifies them exactly as \(A_2,A_3,A_4,A_5\), uses determinant \(5400\) to prove, modulo constants, the restricted miniversal property, and, for the pure-second \(A_2\) and real-even \(A_3\) heat paths, gives \(4/3/2\) and \(4/2/2\) as the distinct count; the latter is transverse only within the real-even slice. This does not complete the global caustic image or prove general three-dimensional Navier--Stokes regularity. R0.72T--W fixes and closes the exact scalar A2 collision block, and R0.72X then, on a fixed physical compact set, obtains the all-start A2 path; Bloch-uniformity still belongs only to that scalar path. R0.72Y starts from Navier--Stokes and rederives the complete Fourier--Leray row, pressure factor two, Orr--Sommerfeld--Squire triangularization, and velocity recovery, then separates, by spatial norm, the scalar invariant row's forcing conclusion: standard H^-1 spacetime transfer is alpha, semiclassical H^-1 spacetime transfer is alpha^2, and the standard endpoint has no vanishing alpha gain. The exact zero-coupling lift-up shows that epsilon-only full-row closure and every-row strict contraction are FALSE. R0.72Z, on the high-gap \(q\)-graph, closes signed OS pressure and orientation-paid Squire history; R0.73A uses the hidden physical mean to close a low-gap \(X_\mu\) finite transient; R0.73B then uses exact Bloch carrier cancellation to close the complete linear velocity/Squire rows' viscous-rate physical-kinetic direct sum. Thus the low-gap vector direct sum at viscous rates is CLOSED; the complete OS--Squire A2 direct sum, sharp \(|\Lambda|\) law, nonlinear Navier--Stokes, and Clay remain OPEN. R0.73C then uses the exact cubic neutral spectrum and a validated periodic-ODE monodromy sign certificate to prove an infinite-dimensional frozen Rayleigh instability; viscous fast-time transfer remains OPEN, and super-polynomial complete-row no-go is only CONDITIONAL. R0.73D then, in the exact kinetic space, proves static vanishing-viscosity persistence of the certified inviscid spectral cluster, operator-norm convergence of the Riesz projections, and preservation of algebraic multiplicity; the general precedent belongs to Shvydkoy--Friedlander, while the complement and fast-time transfer remain OPEN.

zh: 处理 no-slip channel 的 Orr--Sommerfeld 延拓。本节的贡献是一条 explicit double-harmonic Fourier 行在精确 kinetic space 中的自包含证明，并把投影算子范数论证完整写出；不作一般首创、优先权或严格强化声明。
en: treats Orr--Sommerfeld continuation in a no-slip channel. This section contributes a self-contained proof for one explicit double-harmonic Fourier row in the exact kinetic space and fully records the projection operator-norm argument; no claim of general first discovery, priority, or strict strengthening is made.

zh: 当 \(\|P_\varepsilon-P_0\|<1\) 时，两个有限秩投影具有相同秩。对 \(\sigma_*\) 周围的嵌套小圆重复论证，便排除固定簇内特征值停留在远离 \(\sigma_*\) 的位置。因此簇内全部黏性特征值都趋于 \(\sigma_*\)，但本节没有给收敛速率。
en: When \(\|P_\varepsilon-P_0\|<1\), the two finite-rank projections have the same rank. Repeating the argument on nested small circles around \(\sigma_*\) rules out eigenvalues in the fixed cluster remaining away from \(\sigma_*\). Hence every viscous eigenvalue in the cluster converges to \(\sigma_*\), but this section gives no convergence rate.

en: For any R0.73C-supplied \(\sigma_*\in(0.17035,0.17050)\), there exist a fixed circle in the open right half-plane and \(\varepsilon_*>0\). When \(0<\varepsilon<\varepsilon_*\), the viscous spectral cluster exists, the Riesz projections converge in operator norm in the physical kinetic norm, and total algebraic multiplicity is preserved. The circle and threshold are stated only existentially; simplicity and the convergence rate remain unproved.

en: The spectrum of the base operator lies in the closed left half-plane, so its contour integral vanishes. After integration, only \(G_\varepsilon K R_\varepsilon\) remains; this term converges uniformly in operator norm on the contour, directly yielding \(\|P_\varepsilon-P_0\|\to0\).

zh: 在 \(N=96,128\) 间，特征值最大差为 \(2.83\times10^{-15}\)；\(N=128\) 最大嵌入残差为 \(6.46\times10^{-15}\)，全 cutoff 最大残差为 \(1.0294\times10^{-6}\)。独立程序逐项重算后误差为零，但两条路径仍使用同一 NumPy/SciPy binary64 体系，不是 interval 或 infinite-tail certificate。独立解析审计另外纠正了 \(X\) 必须按 completion 定义、\(D(H_0)=L^2\) 不能写成 \(H^2\)，并确认 strong resolvent 本身不足以推出投影范数收敛。所有有限数据继续标为 finite diagnostic only。
en: Between \(N=96,128\), the maximum eigenvalue difference is \(2.83\times10^{-15}\); at \(N=128\), the maximum embedded residual is \(6.46\times10^{-15}\), and the maximum residual over all cutoff values is \(1.0294\times10^{-6}\). The independent program recomputes every term and obtains zero discrepancy, but both paths still use the same NumPy/SciPy binary64 stack and are not an interval or infinite-tail certificate. The independent analytic audit additionally corrected that \(X\) must be defined by completion, that \(D(H_0)=L^2\) cannot be written as \(H^2\), and confirmed that strong resolvent convergence alone is insufficient to imply operator-norm convergence of the projections. All finite data remain labeled finite diagnostic only.

zh: 在稠密核 \(H^2\) 上的 resolvent identity 先给点态收敛，再由一致有界性扩张到全空间。对伴随重复同一论证。强收敛加伴随强收敛可以在紧算子两侧升级为算子范数收敛。
en: On the dense core \(H^2\), the resolvent identity first gives pointwise convergence, which uniform boundedness then extends to the whole space. The same argument is repeated for the adjoints. Strong convergence together with adjoint strong convergence upgrades convergence to operator-norm convergence on both sides of a compact operator.

zh: 这一步关闭了先前最直接的 singular-domain 缺口，也把有限矩阵观察提升为独立于截断的算子定理。它对后续快时间路线有必要价值，但还不充分：没有控制围道外的右半平面谱，没有补空间 semigroup dichotomy，也没有处理随时间变化的剖面。对 Clay 问题的直接价值仍有限。
en: This step closes the most direct singular-domain gap left earlier and upgrades the finite-matrix observation to a truncation-independent operator theorem. It is necessary for the subsequent fast-time route but not sufficient: the right-half-plane spectrum outside the contour is uncontrolled, no complementary-space semigroup dichotomy is available, and time-dependent profiles are untreated. Its direct value for the Clay problem remains limited.

zh: Fourier 矩阵满足 \(|\omega_m-\omega_n|\le|m-n|\)，且 \(\sum_k|k||W_k|=1\)。commutator 有界，随后乘以紧的 \(L^{-1/2}\)，所以 \(K\) 紧。正半平面点谱因此是有限代数重数的孤立谱。
en: The Fourier matrix satisfies \(|\omega_m-\omega_n|\le|m-n|\), and \(\sum_k|k||W_k|=1\). The commutator is bounded and is then multiplied by the compact operator \(L^{-1/2}\), so \(K\) is compact. Point spectrum in the open right half-plane therefore consists of isolated spectral points of finite algebraic multiplicity.
